purpose: Preregistered comparison targets, NOT an inventory of running services

sqlserver.deployment: single server; CU27+GDR October 2026; development/test only

oracle.deployment: single instance; isolated legacy research baseline, not a security baseline

neo4j.durability: normal synchronous transaction commit; effective runtime verification required
neo4j.read_contract: READ COMMITTED target; verify runtime/version semantics before comparison

admission_requirements_before_any_compar: Capture actual server build/edition, binary or image digest, and driver version
Reject actual version/config different from selected profile; never silently use local PostgreSQL 14 as PostgreSQL 17
Verify effective durability, isolation, indexes/collation, resource envelope, and result oracle
Record license/publication review where required; no implied authorization
No cross-product score until comparable adapters and runtime evidence exist
